265-2073-5226--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the Servo.
When the Servo dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
265-2073-5226--90.notes: If the artifact can sacrifice itself, you can do so in lieu of sacrificing the artifact to Lithatog. Also, if the artifact can tap to produce mana (like Sol Ring) or other products, you can do that as well.

1887-2438-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
1887-2438-5254.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

1379-1651-2034-5261-8116.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Frontline Rush without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Frontline Rush, creating two creature tokens that are also artifacts due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping both creature tokens, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing one creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped tokens, you may sacrifice any number of them to add infinite colorless mana.

1479-2841-6662-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-6662-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-6723-6970-7060-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1563-2457-4460-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1580-4871-5147-7316.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4657-5234-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands.
4657-5234-5295-6871.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers three times, adding {3}
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
4657-5234-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

7-4050-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4050-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying at most {1} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

4742-6188-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Fear of Missing Out has vigilance.
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent. There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
4742-6188-6911.description:
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Fear of Missing Out and the Fear of Missing Out token as attackers, choosing to exert the Fear of Missing Out token as it attacks.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1336-1369-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Heronblade Elite.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Heronblade Elite's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Heronblade Elite's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Heronblade Elite's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

5109-5759-6899.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Screaming Nemesis instead due to With Great Power....
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

339-677-1322-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4779-4853-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
4779-4853-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6664-6791.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-6664-6791.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoords

5702-5954-6664-6753.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 3.

2043-5231-6441-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {R}{R}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

2484-4560.description: Cast Blasphemous Act by paying at most {7}{R}, dealing 13 damage to each creature and causing you to gain life equal to the damage dealt this way due to Soulfire Grand Master.

719-1789-2511-5649.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
719-1789-2511-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

413-3174-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
413-3174-5434-5555.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

972-1617-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Saheeli's Artistry.
972-1617-4831-4983-5358.description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
972-1617-4831-4983-5358.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

2178-2438-4147-4215.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-2438-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2438-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Hua Tuo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

662-2743-4483.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
662-2743-4483.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Biovisionary to become an artifact until end of turn.
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

849-1020-1594-3689-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {R}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Workshop Assistant trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {1}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {2}.
Repeat.

165-2034-3263-3560.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one experience counter.
165-2034-3263-3560.description:
Activate Daxos by paying {3}, creating a */* Spirit enchantment creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus and Spirit, adding {4}.
Repeat.

997-4338-4875.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Conspiracy, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

803-2034-3496-4071.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Be'lakor's second ability triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dread Slaver, adding {C}{C}.
When Dread Slaver dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3994-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Precursor Golem.
When Precursor Golem enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Golems, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Golems.

1300-1348-4228.notablePrerequisites:
Bear Umbra attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1300-1348-4228.description:
Declare Weaver of Harmony as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Weaver of Hamony.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying the Weaver of Harmony trigger from step 1.
Resolve the copy of the Weaver of Harmony trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2634-5049-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2634-5049-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the Brass's Bounty copy, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

427-725-2477-4720.notablePrerequisites:
You have drawn at least 6 cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
Aura of Dominion attached to Kydele.
427-725-2477-4720.description:
Tap Kydele for {6}.
Pay {2} to Stonework Packbeast to add {W}.
Pay {3}{W} to Prava to create a 1/1 Soldier token.
Pay {1} and tap the Soldier token to untap Kydele with Aura of Dominion.
Repeat.

890-2410-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Palladium Myr and Myr Galvanizer do not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Myr Galvanizer.
890-2410-4702.description:
Activate Myr Galvanizer by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the Myr Galvanizer token by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Repeat.

1335-2744-4772-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1335-2744-4772-5296.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1}, creating two 1/1 Elemental tokens.
Cathars' Crusade triggers twice, putting four +1/+1 counter to all creatures you control.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
